prompts.background: Use case: precise-object-edit / clean background plate. Edit the reference into a background-only parallax layer. Output 1536x1024, identical camera, composition, color and atmosphere. REMOVE Kisuke Urahara entirely: all hat, face, hair, fan, hands and robe. Reconstruct the Japanese garden and workshop behind him, with mountain silhouettes, rock paths, mist and warm lanterns. Preserve the enormous crimson moon upper right, torii and misty forest, dark green left negative space. Also REMOVE all near-camera red flowers and all loose floating petals, including bottom right and foreground bottom. This is the farthest layer of the same illustration; no people or foreground flower clusters anywhere. Continue the scene seamlessly with richly painted anime ink details. No text, no border, no transparency, no UI. It must look like the same scene with the actor and front flowers lifted out.
prompts.character: Use case: background-extraction / identity-preserve. Extract ONLY Kisuke Urahara from the attached illustration into a real transparent PNG with alpha. Same 1536x1024 canvas, keep EXACT original composition and position: hat starts around x940 y80, face centered x1140 y360, fan centered x1000 y575, dark flowing robe reaches the lower edge. Preserve the smiling face, olive striped hat, black sunglasses, blond hair, folding fan, hands and robe with their original shapes, ink linework, colors, details and lighting. Remove ALL landscape, moon, trees, flowers, petals, fog, sky. Everything outside the character silhouette must be actually transparent, including the entire left half where the character is absent. Restore tiny robe areas previously hidden by floating petals with matching black fabric. Maintain clean precisely cut alpha edges around every hair strand and fan, no white fringe, no checkerboard, no glow, no shadow painted outside silhouette, no new character pose, do not center or enlarge the character. Output a production compositing layer, not a mockup.
prompts.flowers: Use case: background-extraction. Create the separate NEAREST FOREGROUND layer from the attached illustration, on a REAL TRANSPARENT alpha background. Canvas 1536x1024 aligned with the original composition. Only the foreground red camellia flowers and dark olive leaves at the bottom right corner, and a few nearby wind-blown scarlet petals. The flower cluster occupies roughly x1190 to1536 y740 to1024 and spills off the lower/right frame edges, with 2-3 larger softly focused red flowers facing the camera and dark organic stems. Add several detached petals around x1100 y830, x1350 y650, x500 y940 and x800 y770; preserve most of the canvas as completely empty transparency. Match the original warm crimson anime ink and hand-painted shading, depth of field softer nearest bottom edge. No character, no robe, no fan, no hands, no moon, no background, no rectangle, no checkerboard, no lettering. Only flowers, leaves and scattered petals, absolutely transparent everywhere else. This must composite above the character.
prompts.bubble: Use case: illustration-story / UI frame asset. Create a text-free manga speech-bubble FRAME on a real transparent background for the existing Kisuno anime scene, inspired by Kisuke Urahara's Bankai, Benihime surgical reconstruction stitching and red silk thread. Landscape1536x1024. A slightly irregular horizontal rectangular ivory paper speech panel fills90% of canvas, with squared comic corners softened unevenly. Border is sophisticated expressive black manga ink with thin crimson stitches crossing seams, dark scarlet silk cords curving along the edge, two small knotted tassel motifs at diagonally opposite corners, tiny radial ink accents. Strong professional contrast, beautiful controlled hand-drawn shonen manga detail, warm light ivory #f6f0df main paper, dark ink #17291e, deep blood-red accents #9c302d. The central80% of width and75% of height must stay PERFECTLY CLEAN flat light ivory, no texture, no marks, no shading, no ornaments inside this safe text area. All decoration constrained to outer8% edge band. One short pointed speech tail at the middle of the right edge, pointing outwards. Outside the panel and tail is real transparent alpha. No words, no characters, no button, no symbols resembling text, no screenshot, no watermark. Keep visual complexity at the edges so live HTML text and a real button can sit crisply in the center. The reference is only for palette and anime art direction; do not include the reference person or scenery in this frame.
